title: S13 audit-logger — API surface
description: Port 7730, prefix AUD-. Immutable, append-only, hash-chained audit trail. Endpoints: GET /healthz, /readyz, /events, /events/{event_id}, /events/export, /events/verify-chain, /stats; POST /events. Each record's hash = SHA-256 over canonical JSON of (event_id, ts_ns, source, kind, actor, data, prev_hash); the head's prev_hash is the 64-zero constant. ts_ns is server-stamped (submitter timestamps belong in data). Repeat (source, kind, canonical data) within the dedup window folds to the original record. Bounded chain eviction re-severs the head. verify-chain answers 207 when the chain is not intact. Errors: AUD-001 bad JSON (400), AUD-201 invalid event (400), AUD-202 bad id (400), AUD-203 bad limit (400), AUD-204 unknown event (404, evicted flag), AUD-404 no route (404).

eventAppendRequest.description: POST /events — append one event. 'ts_ns' is REJECTED in the body (the server stamps receive time); occurrence timestamps belong inside 'data'.

source.description: Upstream service that produced the event (e.g. execution-gateway).

kind.description: Dotted event kind (e.g. order.submitted, risk.veto, config.updated).

data.description: Arbitrary event payload; hashed as-is into the chain.

dedup_key.description: Optional submitter hint for deduplication; default key derives from (source, kind, canonical data hash).

eventAppendResponse.description: 200 — status is 'appended' (new record) or 'duplicate' (folded to the original, whose record is returned with a 'reason').

eventListResponse.description: GET /events?source=&kind=&limit= — records newest-first; count matches the returned list.

eventGetResponse.description: GET /events/{event_id} — the record plus an on-demand single-record verification. 404 AUD-204 (evicted flag) when unknown.

eventExportResponse.description: GET /events/export?source=&kind=&limit= — a JSON envelope carrying the JSON-lines stream (one compact object per line) so the content type stays application/json; oldest first.

items.description: One canonical (sorted-keys, compact) JSON record per element.

verifyChainResponse.description: GET /events/verify-chain — full walk: every hash and every prev_hash link recomputed. HTTP 200 when intact, 207 (Multi-Status) when not; the body always carries the report.

truncated.description: true when verification stopped at max_verify_depth without reaching a fault.

head_id.description: The current head (oldest surviving) record id; null for an empty chain.

tail_hash.description: Hash of the newest record; null for an empty chain.

first_bad_index.description: Present on failure; 0-based position in chain order.

first_bad_id.description: Present on failure; id of the first offending record.

reason.description: Present on failure (content hash mismatch / broken link).

statsResponse.description: GET /stats — chain length, counters, by_source/by_kind breakdowns, and the last verify report.

eventRecord.description: One hash-chained record (audl.models.EventRecord.to_dict). 'hash' covers (event_id, ts_ns, source, kind, actor, data, prev_hash) via canonical JSON.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the preceding record; the 64-zero constant at the chain head.

verifyChainResponse.description: The verify-chain report object (reused by /stats last_verified).
